note: Kept equal to the action dispatch and the Capability Manifest in native/src/plugin.cpp by tests/check_capabilities.py; liveVerified is set only by a committed live run.

testReachability.reason: connectable once AsaApi reports the server status Ready

getPlayers.reason: UWorld player controllers; gameId = EOS id; steamId + platformId steam:<id> from the EOS Connect Steam mapping, epicOnlineServicesId only for players without Steam

getPlayer.reason: online by EOS id; offline from state/known-players.json

getPlayerLocation.reason: pawn position; offline players give the last position seen since the server started

getPlayerInventory.reason: carried and equipped items of an online player; engrams, hidden items, skins and account cosmetics are left out

getPlayerProgression.reason: one `character` track from the survivor's status component, cached on each getPlayers; a player without a body keeps the last reading

giveItem.reason: AShooterPlayerController.GiveItem by item class path or catalogue name, with quantity, quality and blueprint

listItems.reason: UPrimalGameData.MasterItemList with display names, snapshotted when the world is ready

listEntities.reason: UPrimalGameData dino entries with display names, snapshotted when the world is ready

listLocations.reason: the map's player starts; ARK has no list of named places a server can read

sendMessage.reason: AsaApi chat to all or to one online player, senderNameOverride honoured; a directed message never falls back to a broadcast

executeConsoleCommand.reason: the RCON cheat manager, which exists only with RCONEnabled=True; output of cheat-manager commands is captured

teleportPlayer.reason: AsaApi TeleportToPos, read back to confirm it took effect

banPlayer.reason: the game's ban list; reason and expiresAt kept in state/bans.json, a timed ban is lifted by the connector

listBans.reason: state/bans.json plus bans made in the game from BanList.txt

shutdown.reason: DoExit through the RCON cheat manager, which exists only with RCONEnabled=True; online players are reported as left first

getGameIcon.reason: icon-256.png in the plugin folder, revision from its sha256

getMapInfo.reason: protocol v0 only; the v1 map capability replaces it

getMapTile.reason: the map is the operator's uploaded image of TheIsland_WP; Takaro serves its tiles, the plugin renders none

player-connected.reason: AShooterGameMode.HandleNewPlayer_Implementation hook; a banned player is not reported

player-disconnected.reason: AShooterGameMode.Logout hook, and for every online player on shutdown

chat-message.reason: AsaApi chat callback; tribe chat as team, everything else as global; admin ServerChat arrives with no player

player-death.reason: AShooterGameState.NotifyPlayerDied hook, with the position and a player attacker

entity-killed.reason: APrimalDinoCharacter.Die hook for a kill by a player directly; a kill by a tamed creature is not reported

log.reason: the game's own lines from ShooterGame.log, filtered and budgeted
